verdict.rationale: Rollbar's docs show the building blocks for this story — Items can be marked Resolved and later reactivate (Active/Resolved/Muted/Archived statuses), version and deploy tracking let you see which release reintroduced an error, and notification integrations (Slack, PagerDuty, webhooks) can alert on item events. However, no evidence explicitly documents a distinct 'regression' alert type or reopened-item notification that is differentiated from ordinary new-issue alerts, so an SRE would need to construct this workflow themselves. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a 'reopened/regression' notification trigger distinct from new-item alerts, and any independent/hands-on confirmation that this distinction works in practice.
